speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me if you've been bruising easily or if your gums have been bleeding, and have you noticed any prolonged bleeding after minor cuts or dental procedures? REQUEST TEST: Platelet_count

speaker: Doctor
text: Good, the platelet count is normal, so we can rule out common platelet disorders. Since you have frequent epistaxis and petechiae, have you ever experienced bleeding from your gums or urine without any obvious injury? REQUEST TEST: PT, PTT

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given your normal platelet count and coagulation profile (PT/PTT), I need to investigate whether your bleeding is related to a clotting factor deficiency like Hemophilia, though the normal results make severe classic hemophilia less likely. Could you describe if the bleeding tends to be spontaneous or only after trauma, and does it involve deep muscle hematomas or hemarthrosis (bleeding into joints)?

REQUEST TEST: Factor VIII level, Factor IX level
REQUEST IMAGES: Full_body_photo_of_petechiae_and_bruising

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Factor VIII level: Not provided in current dataset; Factor IX level: Not provided in current dataset. Please note that clinical data indicates a deficiency in GIIb/IIIa receptors on platelet surfaces (from Special_Test: ELISA_Binding_Assay), which suggests a qualitative platelet function disorder rather than a clotting factor deficiency, despite normal PT and PTT. Full body photos of petechiae and bruising are not available in the text-based medical record provided.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Glanzmann Thrombasthenia

This condition is characterized by a defect in the GpIIb/IIIa receptors on platelets, preventing them from clumping together effectively, which explains your spontaneous nosebleeds, gum bleeding, and petechiae despite having a normal platelet count. Since we have identified the specific receptor deficiency, do you have any history of surgery or trauma that resulted in prolonged bleeding times, and have you noticed any other family members with similar bleeding issues?
